## Aquamarine (G4)

Aquamarine is a recurring Ponyville schoolfilly: a small pink Earth pony with a vivid turquoise/sea-green mane and tail, green eyes, and a gem-shaped cutie mark when shown with one. The easiest way to remember her is as the youngster who *bedazzles Apple Bloom's bow* when the Cutie Mark Crusaders become popular in *Twilight Time*.

**Name and speaking.** “Aquamarine” is a **fan/wiki placeholder name**, not a confirmed name used in the episode or official credits; who first proposed it could not be verified. She has **one identifiable spoken line**: “Your gratitude is thanks enough,” after Apple Bloom asks what she owes for the bow decoration. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Twilight_Time). No reliable individual English voice-actor attribution was found. The [Ponyville Schoolhouse roster](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Ponyville_Schoolhouse) lists her under the placeholder name.

**Appearances.** First indexed in *Twilight Time* (S4E15), then visible in *Inspiration Manifestation*, *Crusaders of the Lost Mark*, *The One Where Pinkie Pie Knows*, *Scare Master*, *A Flurry of Emotions*, *Parental Glideance*, *Fame and Misfortune*, *Yakity-Sax*, and *Between Dark and Dawn*. In the time-jump of *The Last Problem* (S9E26), she appears as an adult. See the [character appearance roster](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals?page=1) and [official finale episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3Y8YRe9VknM). There is no verified secret identity or alter ego.

## Important moments

1. **“Your gratitude is thanks enough” — *Twilight Time* (S4E15).** She decorates Apple Bloom's bow, then charmingly refuses payment; this is her distinctive solo dialogue in a story about the Crusaders' sudden popularity. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8wq4ejMZURc) — exact scene timestamp unavailable.
2. **Caught in Flurry Heart's magic — *A Flurry of Emotions* (S7E3).** Among the schoolfoals sick with horsey hives, Aquamarine is present when Flurry Heart levitates hospital beds, leaving Twilight to restore order. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XdJVKscUWtM) — exact scene timestamp unavailable.
